full.description: This is a gross pathology photograph of an adrenal gland specimen sliced in half. The cut surface reveals a large, heterogeneous, fleshy tumor with areas of hemorrhage, necrosis, and variegated coloring. These macroscopic findings are characteristic of an aggressive primary malignant neoplasm of the adrenal cortex. The most likely diagnosis is adrenocortical carcinoma.
